summary: The numbered single-site plan is done. A dropped-in plugin can boot, print assets, save a settings page, store a custom post type, and run its activation hook once when an administrator turns it on. What remains is the worker limits in open.

done.title: WordPress 7.1.4 single-site behavior in the numbered plan
done.note: Schema, core blocks, theme, comments, archives, SEO, fields, forms, security, and the shop slice. See compatibility-plan.md.

done.title: One PHP CLI worker for drop-in plugins
done.note: Hooks, shortcodes, and wp_head and wp_footer echo. ADR-002.

done.title: Store a plugin basename that contains a slash
wp_remote_get and wp_remote_post for public HTTP
Draw plugin settings pages and save registered options
done.note: siteurl, active_plugins, role options, salts, and rustpress_* keys stay refused.

done.title: Register a post type and store its rows
done.note: Admin list and classic editor at /wp-admin/edit.php?post_type={name}. Public permalink is /{slug}/. Revisions and template types are refused. The block editor stays on posts and pages.

done.title: Run activation callbacks when an administrator activates a plugin
done.note: Boot includes active plugins and does not run the hook again.

open.title: is_admin and current_user_can follow the real admin request
open.acceptance: They are true on an authenticated admin request for a capability that user has, and false for a visitor and for a capability that user lacks. The settings-page window is no longer the only case.

open.title: Deactivate one plugin without restarting the worker
open.acceptance: Removing one plugin drops its hooks and shortcodes and leaves the others running.

open.title: Edit a plugin post type in the block editor
open.acceptance: A show_ui type opened from the admin uses the block editor and still cannot switch the row to a refused type.

later.title: get_post_meta and update_post_meta for a dropped-in plugin
later.note: Not in the numbered plan. Do the open items first.

later.title: register_taxonomy with a list screen
later.note: Not in the numbered plan. Do the open items first.

out_of_plan.title: Multisite tables and wp_users.spam and wp_users.deleted
Vendoring wp-admin or wp-includes, or stubbing wp-admin/includes/file.php
WooCommerce lookup tables, variations, coupons, shipping rates, tax, and payment gateways
